title: Interop smoke harness + regression matrix refresh for fallback variants
creator: Asha Patel
description: We need a lightweight, reproducible smoke harness and an automated regression refresh for the fallback variant compatibility matrix. The goal is to detect tokenizer, context-length, and tooling mismatches between primary models and their fallback variants before they affect routing/fallback decisions in production. This ticket covers test harness implementation, integration into CI, telemetry collection for parity signals, and a short remediation playbook for flagged mismatches.
objectives: Implement a modular smoke harness that runs end-to-end sample requests through primary+fallback pairs and reports tokenization diffs
Add context-length compatibility checks (prefix/KV replay) to catch KV cache mismatches
Automate tooling-shim validation (function calling / structured-output examples) for fallback permutations
Integrate checks into the nightly regression job and gate alerts to Slack + Console dashboard
Provide a one-page remediation playbook and link PR templates for fixes
acceptance_criteria: Smoke harness can run against any (primary, fallback) pair with a single CLI command
Regression job executes nightly and writes results to runtime-interop/regressions/YYYY-MM-DD/*
Failures produce a triage ticket template with CLI output, diffs, example prompts, and suggested mitigation (e.g., tokenizer mapping, trim-prefix config, tooling shim)
Telemetry emitted for parity signals (tokenizer-utf8-delta, kv-replay-failure-rate, function-schema-compat) is visible in Console dashboard
Documentation and remediation playbook published in Confluence and linked from the ticket template
tasks: spec: draft smoke harness API and CLI (asha)
impl: harness core runner + sample set loader (luca)
tests: add tokenizer differs and KV replay scenarios (qa)
infra: CI job + S3 path + retention policy (infra)
docs: one-page remediation playbook + PR templates (docs/pm)
rollout: enable nightly for 10 high-risk fallback pairs, evaluate false positive rate (sweeps)
handbook: include runbook steps for on-call when parity alert fires
